Q9015.reason: Metabolism is carried out by enzymes, which are proteins whose structure is dictated by the genetic material; amino acid supply doesn't determine which reactions occur.

Q9017.reason: In a lien theory state the majority view is that a mortgage by one joint tenant doesn't sever the joint tenancy, so the survivor takes the property free of the lien.

Q9018.reason: Under the majority rule, substantial continued at-will employment after signing is adequate consideration for a non-compete, and a contract modification generally still needs consideration.
